display_title: The Secrets of a Possessed Woman
description:
“To become an immortal, one must live a strictly ascetic life.” Yeongsu, a white tiger beastkin who must take the immortal exam in order to become a god, begins to question his desire for divinity after falling in love with Bomi, a human woman. On the day he finally gathers the courage to visit her, Bomi becomes possessed by a frustrated god and starts seducing Yeongsu openly. Unaware of the truth, Yeongsu gradually loses his reason under Bomi’s touch. “Then all I have to do is satisfy you, right, teacher?” In the end, he accepts her proposal…
